test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The average age of a husband and his wife was 20 years at the time of their marriage. After 6 years, they have a 2 -year old child. Find the present average age of the family.
solution:
**Given:**

Average age at the time of marriage = 20 years.

Their child's age after 6 years = 2 years

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Total age at the time of their marriage = 20 × 2

⇒ 40 years

Present age of husband and wife together = 40 + 6 + 6

⇒ 52 years

Total age of the family = 52 + 2 = 54 years

The average age of the family = 54/3 = 18 years

**∴ The present average age of the family is 18 years.**
